# TechTopia

**TechTopia is a technology-focused Minecraft modpack centered around long-term progression, automation, and factory building. Start with primitive tools and gradually unlock new technologies, machines, and production systems as you advance through multiple technological eras.**

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8af5afc25994e68408ea17f80723d435883770ca.png)

✔️ Technology-focused progression

✔️ 100+ Custom Quests

✔️ Create, Applied Energistics 2, and many more mods

✔️ Automation, logistics, and factory building

✔️ Suitable for both new and experienced players

✔️ Multiplayer compatible

✔️ Minecraft 1.19.2

## Progression

Begin with basic resources and simple tools. As you progress through the quest line, you will unlock increasingly advanced machinery, automation systems, storage networks, and production chains.

The modpack is designed around structured progression while still allowing players the freedom to build, automate, and optimize their own factories and production setups.

## Included Content

TechTopia combines a curated selection of technology and automation mods, including:

- Create
- Applied Energistics 2
- Additional technology, storage, and quality-of-life mods

## Important Information

- Designed for long-term survival gameplay
- Quest-driven progression system
- Supports singleplayer and multiplayer
- Requires Minecraft 1.19.2
